<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <?import javafx.scene.chart.PieChart?> <?import javafx.scene.control.*?> <?import javafx.scene.layout.*?> <?import javafx.scene.text.Font?>
<!-- Vue Back Office reponses: historique, stats et edition --> <BorderPane prefHeight="700.0" prefWidth="1000.0" stylesheets="@styles.css" styleClass="app-bg" xmlns="http://javafx.com/javafx/17" xmlns:fx="http://javafx.com/fxml/1" fx:controller="com.hospismart.hospismartdesktop.controllers.ReponseBackController"> <left> <VBox prefWidth="250" style="-fx-background-color: #1a2533; -fx-padding: 20 0 20 0;" spacing="10"> <!-- Header Logo --> <HBox alignment="CENTER" style="-fx-padding: 0 0 20 0;"> <Label text="HospiSmart" style="-fx-text-fill: white; -fx-font-size: 20px; -fx-font-weight: bold;"/> <Label text="ADMIN" style="-fx-background-color: #1e3656; -fx-text-fill: #4da6ff; -fx-padding: 2 6; -fx-background-radius: 4; -fx-font-size: 10px; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-translate-x: 10;"/> </HBox>
<!-- Profile Info --> <VBox alignment="CENTER" spacing="5" style="-fx-padding: 0 0 20 0;"> <Region style="-fx-background-color: #2196f3; -fx-min-width: 70; -fx-min-height: 70; -fx-max-width: 70; -fx-max-height: 70; -fx-background-radius: 35; -fx-border-color: white; -fx-border-radius: 35; -fx-border-width: 2;"/> <Label text="Admin System" style="-fx-text-fill: white; -fx-font-size: 14px; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-padding: 10 0 0 0;"/> <Label text="GESTIONNAIRE" style="-fx-text-fill: #8595a6; -fx-font-size: 11px;"/> </VBox>
<Region style="-fx-border-width: 0 0 1 0; -fx-border-color: #2a3a4d; -fx-padding: 0 20 10 20;"/>
<!-- Navigation --> <VBox spacing="10" VBox.vgrow="ALWAYS" style="-fx-padding: 10 15;"> <Label text="OVERVIEW" style="-fx-text-fill: #8595a6; -fx-font-size: 10px; -fx-padding: 0 0 5 10;"/> <Button text=" Dashboard" style="-fx-alignment: CENTER_LEFT; -fx-background-color: transparent; -fx-text-fill: white; -fx-font-size: 13px; -fx-padding: 10 15; -fx-cursor: hand;" prefWidth="220" maxWidth="Infinity"/>
<Label text="MA CLINIQUE" style="-fx-text-fill: #8595a6; -fx-font-size: 10px; -fx-padding: 15 0 5 10;"/> <Button text=" Reclamations" onAction="#goToReclamations" style="-fx-alignment: CENTER_LEFT; -fx-background-color: transparent; -fx-text-fill: #aebfd1; -fx-font-size: 13px; -fx-padding: 10 15; -fx-cursor: hand;" prefWidth="220" maxWidth="Infinity"/> <Button text=" Réponses" style="-fx-alignment: CENTER_LEFT; -fx-background-color: #144b82; -fx-text-fill: white; -fx-font-size: 13px; -fx-font-weight: bold; -fx-padding: 10 15; -fx-background-radius: 6; -fx-cursor: hand;" prefWidth="220" maxWidth="Infinity"/> </VBox>
<!-- Logout --> <VBox style="-fx-padding: 0 15;"> <Button text=" Déconnexion" style="-fx-alignment: CENTER_LEFT; -fx-background-color: transparent; -fx-text-fill: #aebfd1; -fx-font-size: 13px; -fx-padding: 10 15; -fx-cursor: hand;" prefWidth="220" maxWidth="Infinity"/> </VBox> </VBox> </left> <!-- Zone centrale: KPIs, recherche, chart, table et actions --> <center> <VBox styleClass="page-content" spacing="12.0"> <HBox alignment="CENTER_LEFT" spacing="20"> <Label text="Historique des Réponses" styleClass="header-title" style="-fx-background-color: #2C3E50; -fx-padding: 10 14; -fx-background-radius: 10;" HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS" maxWidth="Infinity"/> </HBox>
<!-- Cartes KPI du dashboard des reponses --> <HBox styleClass="kpi-wrap"> <VBox styleClass="kpi-card" HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"> <Label fx:id="lblTotalReponses" text="0" styleClass="kpi-value"/> <Label text="Total réponses" styleClass="kpi-label"/> </VBox> <VBox styleClass="kpi-card" HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"> <Label fx:id="lblAdminsActifs" text="0" styleClass="kpi-value"/> <Label text="Admins actifs" styleClass="kpi-label"/> </VBox> <VBox styleClass="kpi-card" HBox.hgrow="ALWAYS"> <Label fx:id="lblReclamationsRepondues" text="0" styleClass="kpi-value"/> <Label text="Réclamations répondues" styleClass="kpi-label"/> </VBox> </HBox>
<HBox spacing="10" alignment="CENTER_LEFT"> <Label text="Recherche :"/> <TextField fx:id="txtRecherche" promptText="Rechercher une réponse..." prefWidth="250"/> </HBox>
<!-- Camembert: repartition des reponses par administrateur --> <PieChart fx:id="chartReponses" title="Répartition des réponses par admin" legendVisible="true" labelsVisible="true" prefHeight="340.0" minHeight="320.0"/>
<TableView fx:id="tableReponse" onMouseClicked="#handleTableClick" VBox.vgrow="ALWAYS" styleClass="card">
<columns> <TableColumn fx:id="colContenu" text="Contenu de la Réponse" prefWidth="250" /> <TableColumn fx:id="colAdminNom" text="Admin" prefWidth="120" /> <TableColumn fx:id="colAdminEmail" text="Email Admin" prefWidth="150" /> <TableColumn fx:id="colDate" text="Date de Réponse" prefWidth="130" /> </columns> </TableView>
<!-- Formulaire de modification/suppression d'une reponse --> <TitledPane text="Modification et Suppression des Réponses" collapsible="false"> <VBox spacing="10" styleClass="card"> <GridPane hgap="15" vgap="10"> <Label text="Contenu :" GridPane.columnIndex="0" GridPane.rowIndex="0"/> <TextArea fx:id="txtReponse" prefRowCount="3" GridPane.columnIndex="1" GridPane.rowIndex="0" GridPane.columnSpan="3"/>
<Label text="Nom Admin :" GridPane.columnIndex="0" GridPane.rowIndex="1"/> <TextField fx:id="txtAdminNom" GridPane.columnIndex="1" GridPane.rowIndex="1"/>
<Label text="Email Admin :" GridPane.columnIndex="2" GridPane.rowIndex="1"/> <TextField fx:id="txtAdminEmail" GridPane.columnIndex="3" GridPane.rowIndex="1"/> <columns> <TableColumn fx:id="colContenu" text="Contenu de la Réponse" prefWidth="250" /> <HBox spacing="12" alignment="CENTER_LEFT" style="-fx-padding: 12 0 0 0;"> <Button text="Modifier la Réponse" onAction="#modifierReponse" styleClass="btn btn-primary"/> <Button text="Supprimer la Réponse" onAction="#supprimerReponse" styleClass="btn btn-danger"/> <Button text="Rafraîchir" onAction="#actualiser" styleClass="btn btn-neutral"/> </HBox> </VBox> </TitledPane> </VBox> </center> </BorderPane>
